chapter.title: Act IV: The Longest Night
subtitle: Winter, Year One
Keep everyone warm and fed through winter, and finish Josie's power plant so the valley never has to go dark again.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.

quests.title: Sleep One Night, Then Follow Pip to the Inn
quests.subtitle: The Hearth has gone out.
description: Pip, at your door, out of breath: "The Hearth's out! It's been out since supper and Aunt Marnie is just standing there looking at it!"

Sleep one night in your own bed, then walk down the hill to the inn. Everyone is already inside it. Marnie banked that fire the way she has every night for thirty years, and it went out anyway, and nobody can tell you why.
Opens the winter book and hands you 64 Firewood Bundles, a winter cloak and Marnie's cocoa.

tasks.title: A night slept, and the whole valley already inside the inn

rewards.title: The Winter Book Opens
rewards.description: Next: 16 Firewood Bundles each to Marnie, Halden, Nella and Oda.

quests.title: Fill the Four Firewood Stacks, 16 Each
quests.subtitle: Marnie's, Halden's, Nella's and Oda's.
description: Oda, not looking up from the ledger: "Four houses, sixteen bundles each. That is sixty-four, which is exactly what you were given."
Put 16 Firewood Bundles into each of the four marked stacks in the inn's back room: Marnie's, Halden's, Nella's and Oda's. Any order is right.
Each of them gives something back, and Wisp lights a lantern path down the frozen river.

rewards.title: Four Stacks Filled
rewards.description: Next: walk the frozen river to the reed village and bring the Ribbits home.

quests.title: Walk the Frozen River, Bring the Ribbits Home
quests.subtitle: Follow Wisp's lanterns downstream and back.
description: Wisp: "The reeds is all ice now, and we are four with no roof. Can we be your neighbours nearer?"

The river is solid — walk it. Follow Wisp's lit lanterns downstream to the reed village and talk to Reed, Sedge, Mudlark and Puddle. They pack up and walk back to the inn on their own; you only have to be the one who went and asked.
Four Ribbits move into town for good, Wisp stops being a visitor, and Nella hands you her Ice Auger.

tasks.title: Reach the reed village and walk the Ribbits back to the inn

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "Wisp lit the way. You walk it.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Four Ribbits, Moved In
rewards.description: Next: cook 12 bowls of Vegetable Soup for the long table at the inn. Nella's Ice Auger goes through the lake whenever you want it.

quests.title: Cook 12 Vegetable Soup for the Long Table
quests.subtitle: One bowl for every seat.
description: Marnie, quietly: "I have fed this room for thirty years, and tonight I'm sitting down at it. Don't make a thing of it."
Cook 12 bowls of Vegetable Soup in the Cooking Pot and set them on the long table at the inn — one for every seat.
The Hearth relights, Marnie sits down at her own table, and the greenhouse shell goes up on the square with its glazing stacked inside.

rewards.title: The Hearth Is Lit Again
rewards.description: Next: glaze the greenhouse shell on the square. Six windows, one door and eight planters are already in your bag.

quests.title: Cut the Ice for Muskellunge and Rainbow Trout
quests.subtitle: Nella's Ice Auger goes through it.
description: Nella, flat: "Lake's a floor now, and the auger goes through it. Fish underneath don't know it's winter."

Cut a hole in the lake ice with Nella's Ice Auger, then catch 4 Muskellunge and 4 Rainbow Trout through it. Both want the deep cold out past the pier — cut where the ice is dark, not white, and put a worm on the hook.
Winter tackle and two trophy mounts for the inn wall — and Nella has something to do until spring.

rewards.title: Two on the Inn Wall
rewards.description: Next: Halden's rounds — brew 8 Winter Tonics, one for each resident.

quests.title: Brew 8 Winter Tonics, One for Each Neighbour
quests.subtitle: At Halden's still, west of the square.
description: Halden, slowly: "Eight people, eight bottles. I would go round myself, but they talk to you more than they talk to me."

Brew 8 Winter Tonics at Halden's still, west of the square by the hedge garden. A Flask, a Green Tea Leaf and one sugar makes two, and his hedge-gate crate left you four flasks and sixteen leaves. Hold all eight at hand-in.
Nobody in the valley gets sick this winter, and Halden stops being the only one who checks.

rewards.title: Halden's Rounds Walked
rewards.description: Next: run 5 of Pip's courier parcels out of the Delivery Crate.

quests.title: Run 5 Courier Parcels From the Delivery Crate
quests.subtitle: One click each — the crate fills them.
description: Pip: "I am the courier and the satchel has my name on it! Five parcels and then cocoa!"
Take 5 Courier Parcels out of the Delivery Crate beside Oda's board and run them. One click each now — the crate fills them for you.
Pip keeps the satchel, the duckling finishes growing up, and the Duck Plushie is yours.

rewards.title: Pip Is the Courier
rewards.description: Next: glaze the greenhouse shell — six windows, one door, eight planters on the marked bench.

quests.title: Glaze the Greenhouse Shell and Hang Its Door
quests.subtitle: 6 windows, a door, 8 planters on the bench.
description: Nella: "Nothing grows in it yet. I'll sit in it anyway — it's the only quiet room in town."

Put one Oak Window in each of the six frames of the greenhouse shell on the square, hang the Oak Cottage Door, and set 8 Planters on the marked bench. All fifteen came over in Marnie's soup crate. Any order is right.
The shell becomes a room the coolant loop can heat, and the inn's solstice dressing — twelve of each — comes off the same wagon.

tasks.title: Six windows in, door hung, eight planters on the bench

rewards.title: The Greenhouse Is Glazed
rewards.description: Next: dress the inn for the solstice — twelve marked copper tiles.

quests.title: Dress the Inn's Twelve Tiles for the Solstice
quests.subtitle: A candle holder, a sconce and a flower box each.
description: Marnie: "Twelve spots. The solstice is the solstice, even in a year like this one has been."
Set a Candle Holder, a Sconce and a Flower Box on each of the twelve marked copper tiles in the inn — thirty-six pieces, all out of the greenhouse crate. Any order is right.
Sixteen more of each in the crate, and Marnie's mulled cider goes on the hob.

tasks.title: All twelve marked copper tiles dressed

rewards.title: The Inn Is Dressed
rewards.description: Next: bake 4 Bread with Pip on the stool.

quests.title: Bake 4 Bread With Pip at the Inn Oven
quests.subtitle: He can reach if he stands on the stool.
description: Pip: "I can reach if I stand on the stool! Aunt Marnie says I can reach and Aunt Marnie is right!"
Bake 4 Bread at the inn's oven with Pip on the stool beside you.
Pip gets his own apron, and you keep the one loaf he made himself. It is not good. It is his. Marnie sends her loom over with 24 wool.

rewards.title: Pip's Own Loaf
rewards.description: Next: shear the flock and make 3 Blankets, one per empty house. Marnie's loom, the shears and 24 wool came over with the bread.

quests.title: Shear the Flock and Make 3 Blankets
quests.subtitle: One blanket per empty house.
description: Marnie: "Three empty houses, three beds, three blankets. People arrive in spring, and beds should be made before they get here."
Shear the flock in the pasture until you have 24 wool, then craft 3 Blankets at any crafting table — eight wool around one string each. The wool and the string came with Pip's baking.
The three blankets go onto the three beds in the empty houses, and whatever wool is left over stays in your chest.

rewards.title: Three Beds Made
rewards.description: Next: cut the ice, brew Halden's eight tonics, run Pip's five parcels. Three beds made, and the greenhouse stays cold until somebody pulls that lever.

quests.title: Furnish the Bathhouse's Twelve Marked Spots
quests.subtitle: Twelve marked spots behind the inn.
description: Bram: "Built it, piped it, didn't furnish it. That end's not mine."
Furnish the bathhouse behind the inn: an Oak Bench, an Oak Shelf and a Lantern to each of its twelve marked spots. Bram's coolant-loop crate left all thirty-six on the floor. Any order is right.
Twelve more benches, shelves and lanterns come back with it, and the bathhouse opens: Bram's waste heat becomes a room people sit in.

tasks.title: Every marked spot in the bathhouse furnished

rewards.title: The Bathhouse Opens
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's safety check at the Reactor Terminal closes the act.

quests.title: Open the Works
quests.subtitle: Forty marked blocks of fall, then the Waystone.
description: Tobin, fast: "The fall is forty blocks of it, I paced it twice, and behind forty blocks is the entire works, and I have not slept."
Mine the 40 marked blocks out of the fallen adit into Josie's Works, then place the Waystone on the marked plinth inside. The Works Pick came with the cellar wall.
The Works lights up, her Flux Drill is on the bench charged and ready for the yellorite, and there is a saddled horse in the stable.

tasks.title: Adit cleared and the Works Waystone placed inside

rewards.command: /tellraw @a [{"text":"Bram: ","color":"gray"},{"text":"Four years I have known that boiler never cracked and never said so. Right — where do you want the duct.","italic":true}]
/tellraw @a [{"text":"Tobin: ","color":"yellow"},{"text":"She left the adit breathing eleven years so the works would not damp out, and I noticed the warm grass in July.","italic":true}]
title @p subtitle {"text": "Forty blocks of fall, the works behind.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The Works Is Open
rewards.description: Next: run Energy Duct from the mill to the Works and fit 2 Energy Cells. Your new compass already points at the Wandering Merchant's Tower.

quests.title: Duct the Mill to the Works, Fit 2 Cells
quests.subtitle: Then two Thermal Energy Cells at the Works end.
description: Bram: "Mill makes it, Works needs it, duct in between. You have done this once already."
Run Energy Duct from the mill to the Works, then install 2 Thermal Energy Cells at the Works end of the line.
The Works has power, and everything from here to the reactor runs on it. It is still not yours: Josie left it to whoever the valley trusts.

tasks.title: Energy Duct run from the mill to the Works

rewards.title: The Works Has Power
rewards.description: Next: take that compass to the Wandering Merchant's Tower and fetch the second Kettle Plate.

quests.title: Fetch the Second Kettle Plate From the Tower
quests.subtitle: The compass from the Works already points at it.
description: Josie, in the margin: "Second plate went out with the tower trader. He always did want it more than he could read it."

Take the Explorer's Compass you were handed at the Works — already set to the Wandering Merchant's Tower — click the Waystone standing at its gate, and bring the Kettle Plate out of the vault chest inside.
Josie's Turbine Notes come back with it: Bigger Reactors casings become craftable.

tasks.title: Vault chest open at the Wandering Merchant's Tower

rewards.command: execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Turbine Notes in Hand
rewards.description: Next: build a Molecular Assembler and a 4k Crafting Storage into the Works network.

quests.title: Build a Molecular Assembler and 4k Storage
quests.subtitle: Into the ME network at the Works.
description: Tobin: "You can keep making casings by hand, or the network can while you eat. I recommend the network, strongly, and I have listed why."
Craft 1 Molecular Assembler and 1 4k Crafting Storage and put them into the ME network at the Works.
The network crafts casings while you eat: CPU housing, four co-processors, four ME Interfaces, and 32 sticks of powder on Josie's map.

rewards.title: The Network Crafts It
rewards.description: Next: follow Josie's yellorite map, now in your bag, from the Works Waystone to the pocket.

quests.title: Mine 64 Uranium From Josie's Pocket
quests.subtitle: Josie's yellorite map, from the Works Waystone.
description: Tobin: "Her map puts the pocket a fixed walk from the Works waystone. Josie's surveys have never once been wrong."

Follow Josie's yellorite map from the Works Waystone to the pocket and mine 64 uranium ore. Every block drops a cluster and every cluster smelts one for one, so 64 in the hole is 64 in your bag. "Yellorium" is her shorthand for it.
Your own network auto-crafts 64 Reactor Casings while you walk back.

rewards.title: 64 Casings, Auto-Crafted
rewards.description: Next: assemble the vessel — 64 casings, terminal, 8 fuel rods, 4 control rods, an access port and 2 coolant ports.

quests.title: Build the Vessel
quests.subtitle: Four rod columns, two tall, on the marked pad.
description: Bram: "Shell, terminal, fuel rods, control rods, access port, two coolant ports — build it square. Her drawing's on the wall behind you."

Assemble the vessel on the Works pad: 64 Reactor Casings, 1 Terminal, 8 Fuel Rods, 4 Control Rods, 1 Access Port, 2 Coolant Ports. Four rod columns two rods tall, a coolant port on each long face. Without the pair it runs passive.
Computer port, redstone port, four more pages of Josie's notes — and Bram's turbine crate, which is the whole bill for the next quest.

tasks.title: Vessel assembled and reading valid on the terminal

rewards.title: The Vessel Is Square
rewards.description: Next: build the turbine to a fixed budget and hold 1,800 RPM under load.

quests.title: Tune the Turbine to 1,800 RPM Under Load
quests.subtitle: Hold it there, then run /valley check turbine.
description: Bram: "Crate's got what it's got — blades, coils, casing. Get it to eighteen hundred RPM under load and hold it there."

Build the turbine out of Bram's crate: 64 Turbine Casing, 16 Turbine Glass, 2 Rotor Bearings one at each end, 6 Shafts, 16 Blades, 2 Fluid Ports and 16 copper blocks for the coil ring. Hold 1,800 RPM under load without going over.
The lever goes live, and her own figures get pencilled into your journal margin.

rewards.title: 1,800 RPM, Held
rewards.description: Next: run the coolant loop to the 6 greenhouse heaters and the bathhouse tank.

quests.title: Duct the Coolant Loop to the Town
quests.subtitle: Josie's rule: the heat goes to the town.
description: Josie's rule, in her own hand: "The waste heat goes to the town, not the sky. Anything else is a fire you paid for twice."
Run Fluid Duct and Energy Duct from the reactor to the 6 greenhouse heaters on the square, and to the bathhouse tank behind the inn.
Six heaters and the bathhouse tank come up warm, the bathhouse benches, shelves and lanterns land in your bag, and the glass lights itself.

tasks.title: All 6 greenhouse heaters connected and running

rewards.title: Glass That Lights Itself
rewards.description: Next: fetch Bram from the mill, and take the cocoa with you. The bathhouse behind the inn is piped and bare — twelve marked spots.

quests.title: Bring Bram to the Inn With a Hot Cocoa
quests.subtitle: He will say no. Take the cocoa anyway.
description: Marnie: "He'll say the mill needs him at midnight in January. Take the cocoa anyway, and don't argue with him about it."
Walk to the mill, click Bram to take his token, and hand him 1 Hot Cocoa. He will say no, then he will put his tools down and walk down with you.
Bram puts his tools down, his father's wrench is yours, and the lever is his to pull.

rewards.title: Bram Sits Down
rewards.description: Next: place the last 17 lamp posts, mill to square to lake.

quests.title: Place the Last 17 Lamp Posts, Mill to Lake
quests.subtitle: Lamps 39 of 40. One post stays bare.
description: Josie, page forty: "Forty posts, mill to square to lake. I counted them on my fingers before I could count to forty."
Place the last 17 lamp posts on the marked spots, mill to square to lake. Any order is right. The duct runs itself along the line as you go, and not one of them lights until Bram pulls the lever.
Lamps 39 of 40. One post stays bare on purpose: Josie's porch.

tasks.title: All 17 marked lamp posts placed, mill to square to lake

rewards.title: Lamps 39 / 40
rewards.description: Next: Tobin's safety check at the Reactor Terminal. Then Bram pulls the lever.

quests.title: Read the Three Numbers, Hand Bram the Lever
quests.subtitle: Act IV finale — the Longest Night.
description: Tobin, calm for once: "Fuel, coolant, rods — I check them, I sign it, Bram pulls it. That's the order, and I wrote it down twice."

Open the Reactor Terminal in the Works and read all three off its screen — fuel level, coolant flow, control-rod insertion — then tell Tobin the numbers are good and hand Bram the lever. No command for this one: you tick it yourself.
Forty lamps. Fifteen people. One winter that nobody leaves.
Tonight the valley keeps its own lights on, and it does not need anybody in this room to stay awake to do it.

tasks.title: Fuel, coolant and rods read off the terminal

rewards.command: /tellraw @p [{"text":"Oda: ","color":"gold"},{"text":"One hundred Scrip against your name. I have never written a number that large in this book, so I wrote it twice.","color":"white","italic":true}]

rewards.title: The Longest Night
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night, then walk the square with Marnie. Tobin wants a second turbine off the same reactor without moving the fuel line.
